com.unitech.lib.uhf.params

Class SelectMask6cParam

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.unitech.lib.uhf.params.SelectMask6cParam

  • public class SelectMask6cParam
extends java.lang.Object
    The SelectMask6cParam class is a class for providing the capability to set Selection Mask conditions on RFID UHF modules at once.

    • Constructor Detail

      • SelectMask6cParam

        public SelectMask6cParam()
        Creates an instance of the SelectMask6cParam class.

      • SelectMask6cParam

        public SelectMask6cParam(boolean used,
                         Mask6cTarget target,
                         Mask6cAction action,
                         BankType bank,
                         int offset,
                         java.lang.String pattern,
                         int length)
        Creates an instance of the SelectMask6cParam class.
        Parameters:
        used - A boolean indicating whether to use the condition of "Selection Mask".
        target - The Mask6cTarget enumeration indicating the flag of the tag to store the result of the "Selection Mask" condition.
        action - The Mask6cAction enumeration indicating how to save the results for the condition of "Selection Mask".
        bank - The BankType enumeration representing the memory bank of the tag to compare the pattern in "Selection Mask".
        offset - An integer representing the start address at which to begin comparing patterns in the "Selection Mask". The unit is bit.
        pattern - A string representing the comparison pattern for "Selection Mask".
        length - An integer representing the length of the pattern in "Selection Mask". The unit is bit.
